notes.title: StarCraft rival Synchronizers Undead Marines turns RTS tropes on their heads
notes.content:
No, I didn't just pick up Synchronizers Undead Marines because the titular warriors look kind of like Space Marines. Let's just get that out of the way. They do, in a way, but that's not why this game caught my attention. It was coincidental. Pretty cool, but coincidental nonetheless. I wanted to talk about Synchronizers: Undead Marines because of its unique take on StarCraft-esque strategy, how it turns RTS tropes on their heads to create what the devs call a "reverse tower defense" game. If that's not enough to catch your attention, I don't know what will. Also, the soldiers look like Space Marines.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: SYNCHRONIZERS: Undead Marines DEMO, out now!
notes.content:
Hi guys, this is Ale Navarro, solo dev behind "Synchronizers: Undead Marines".
I'm very excited because I just released a demo with alpha gameplay so you can give it a try! 
Unit upgrades, in-game store, Command Center and other very important features are not included this time.

Currently I'm working on bug fixing and new features of the game such as different units and the planets selection :)

I hope you enjoy this, and you can follow the project in the instagram @synchronizers.thegame
Have a great week.

Cheers!

PS: Comments and new ideas to be implemented in the future are welcome!
